caption: The drawing depicts two views of a small, rectangular shack with a slanted roof. The shack is painted green with darker green stripes and has a red roof section, red borders around the window, and red trim along the roof edges. The structure sits on a brown base. On the left side of the image, the shack is seen from the front, with an open doorway revealing a person standing inside. The person has dark skin, wears a red shirt, blue pants, yellow suspenders, and black shoes. The front-facing wall of the shack features painted or possibly affixed objects: a black star-shaped item, a banjo or stringed instrument, and another tool-like object. There is a small window with a red frame on the front wall. The right side of the image displays a rear or side view of the same shack, showing the striped green and red exterior and the same style of window and banjo affixed to the wall. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, in a light beige or off-white color. The artist's signature, "Clementine Hunter," appears at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Bank: Toy Building with Figure
